Clean one LOBSTER day and aggregate it to snapshots

Source: R/process.R
lobster_process.Rd

Runs lobster_clean() and lobster_snapshots() for one day, given either the day's message and order book files or a LOBSTER .7z archive and a date. Files inside the archive are streamed, never unpacked to disk.

Usage

lobster_process(
  message_file = NULL,
  orderbook_file = NULL,
  archive = NULL,
  date = NULL,
  freq = 5,
  split_edges = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

message_file, orderbook_file

character(1) or NULL Paths of the day's files, or member names inside archive. When archive is given they can be left out and are then found by date.

archive

character(1) or NULL Path to a LOBSTER .7z archive.

date

Date or character(1) The trading day to process from archive; not needed when the archive holds a single day.

freq

numeric(1) Snapshot interval in seconds.

split_edges

logical(1) Passed to lobster_snapshots().

...

Further arguments for lobster_clean(), e.g. trading_hours, depth_bp or cut_at_crosses.

Value

The snapshots, as returned by lobster_snapshots(). Crosses, halts and the cleaning log are available with lobster_crosses(), lobster_halts() and lobster_log().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
snaps <- lobster_process(
  archive = "SPY_2024-02-27_2024-03-26_50.7z",
  date = "2024-03-20"
)
lobster_crosses(snaps)

# all days of an archive
days <- lobster_archive_files("SPY_2024-02-27_2024-03-26_50.7z")
snaps <- lapply(days$date, function(d) {
  lobster_process(archive = "SPY_2024-02-27_2024-03-26_50.7z", date = d)
})
} # }
